Dear Hiring Team,

I'd like to apply for the Marketing Coordinator role for Benelux and the Nordics.

Based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, I've spent my recent years in hands-on digital marketing: managing CMS content and SEO for client websites at Episto, supporting SharePoint-based digital workplace builds for large retail and logistics clients at KXP, and running my own freelance web and search projects. That work means keeping several clients, markets and deadlines moving at once while keeping colleagues and clients aligned on what goes live and when.

I hold HubSpot's Content Marketing certificate, work daily in Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs, and spent a year on a healthcare web application at ViviDoctor - so the veterinary technology space genuinely appeals to me. English is fluent; my Dutch is B1 in writing and improving.

I'd welcome the chance to talk about the Benelux plan.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Marketing Coordinator role covering Belgium, the Netherlands and Sweden.

The way you describe the position - planning and delivering regionally while keeping global campaigns relevant in each market, and acting as the link between the marketing team and the Benelux commercial team - is close to how I already work. At Episto I run on-page SEO, keyword research and content for multiple client websites, publishing and updating pages, posts and media in WordPress while tracking results in Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. At Knowledge Experts I supported the build of SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for SOK Market and Aras Kargo, where the daily job was coordinating between client stakeholders, designers and developers to keep delivery on track and content consistent.

Content and brand consistency are habits I've had to build: for a pharmacists' association I maintain a uniform template and structure across roughly 600 member profile pages, and across client sites I keep layouts, messaging and publishing standards aligned while working at volume. Reporting comes with it - I'm Semrush SEO certified, hold the HubSpot Content Marketing certificate, and use GA4, Search Console and Google Ads to see what's actually performing.

I haven't run veterinary congresses before, but this role is hands-on and I'm comfortable learning the event side quickly; organising multiple clients, markets and deadlines is the part I do every day. And while my English is fluent, my Dutch is at B1 writing level - I live and work in Belgium and I'm actively improving it, so I can take on Dutch-language content and coordination with support early on.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and happy to travel across Benelux with occasional trips to Sweden, the UK and wider Europe. I also spent a year as a front-end developer on a healthcare web application at ViviDoctor, so an organisation improving animal care through technology is one I'd enjoy supporting.

I'd be glad to discuss how I can help your Benelux team.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
- Based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, available for regular Benelux travel plus occasional Sweden, UK and wider Europe trips; English fluent, Dutch at B1 writing / A2+ speaking and improving
- HubSpot Content Marketing certified, plus Google Analytics GA4, Google Ads Search and Semrush SEO certifications
- CMS and content coordination at volume across WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math) and Shopify: publishing and updating pages, blog posts, media and product catalogues, with consistent layouts and brand standards
- Multi-stakeholder coordination: client website work at Episto, and SharePoint digital workplace delivery for SOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff) at KXP
- Performance tracking with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs and Google Ads, plus healthcare-sector exposure as front-end developer on the ViviDoctor healthcare web application
